title: Client Reporting Periods and Letter Stop Terms, Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs
content:
# Client Obligations Sheet — Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs: Reporting and Letter Stops

Because debtors under the Flat-Fee Pre-Collect Programs pay the creditor client directly, each pack size sets how quickly the client reports a debtor payment, how quickly a paid-in-full report stops the letters, how long a partial-payment report pauses them, how long the client has to supply verification of a disputed debt, and whether a dispute or a cease request stops the letters.

| Pack | Client reports a debtor payment within (calendar days of receiving it) | Series stops after a paid-in-full report within (business days) | Series pause after a partial-payment report (calendar days) | Client supplies verification after a dispute within (calendar days) | Dispute stops the letters until verification is mailed | Written cease request stops the letters for good |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| First Notice 50-Unit Program | 5 | 2 | 30 | 15 | Yes | Yes |
| First Notice 150-Unit Program | 5 | 2 | 30 | 15 | Yes | Yes |
| First Notice 300-Unit Program | 5 | 2 | 30 | 21 | Yes | Yes |
| First Notice 600-Unit Program | 3 | 1 | 30 | 21 | Yes | Yes |
| First Notice 1200-Unit Program | 3 | 1 | 45 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| First Notice 2500-Unit Program | 2 | 1 | 45 | 30 | Yes | Yes |

## Reading the sheet

- **Reporting period.** Counted in calendar days from the day the client receives the debtor's payment: 5 days on the three smallest packs, 3 days on the First Notice 600-Unit and 1200-Unit Programs, and 2 days on the First Notice 2500-Unit Program.
- **Paid-in-full stop.** Counted in business days after the paid-in-full report: 2 business days on the three smallest packs and 1 business day on the three largest.
- **Partial-payment pause.** The number of calendar days the series pauses after the client reports a partial payment: 30 days up to the First Notice 600-Unit Program, 45 days on the 1200-unit and 2500-unit packs.
- **Verification period.** The calendar days the client has to supply verification after a debtor disputes: 15, 21 or 30 days by pack size.
- **Dispute stop and cease stop.** On every pack size a dispute stops the series until verification is mailed, and a debtor's written cease request stops the series for good.

## A hypothetical comparison

A client receives a debtor's payment on a hypothetical day 0. Under a First Notice 150-Unit Program pack the report is due within 5 calendar days of that receipt; under a First Notice 2500-Unit Program pack, within 2.
